name: Roque Conceição Moreira Jr.
summary: A Brazilian flyweight (12-3 after his Contender Series win), a former Demo Fight and Thunder Fight champion. He was knocked out on his first Contender Series appearance, then won his contract in October with a R1 triangle choke of Alexander Chavez. UFC debut. Our data has no record for him yet.

how_they_fight.Striking: Was out-boxed and knocked out in his first Contender Series fight.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Triangle-choke submission on the Contender Series.
how_they_fight.Defense: Three losses: a knockout and two decisions.

concerns: Knocked out by a boxer on his first Contender Series appearance

news.text: Won a UFC contract with a R1 triangle choke of Alexander Chavez.
